scientific_question: When only bounded action-labelled trajectories are visible, is stable probe-relative object identity determined across every compatible ECA dynamics pair, underdetermined, or determined only because the hidden rules have been uniquely identified?

engine_contract.julia: independent exact transition, version-space, stable-partition, and query-consensus ledger
engine_contract.jax: independent batched exhaustive version-space and relation-consensus ledger
engine_contract.controller: fieldwise closed-receipt comparison, corruption attacks, and fail-closed regime classification
engine_contract.pytorch: excluded: this scout decides whether a learning task is informationally admissible

parent_exact_result.use: source semantics and finite-carrier boundary only; engines must recompute labels and may not read parent engine results

carrier.stable_relation: exact behavioral equivalence under both candidate actions and the fixed probe

rule_family_split.single_rule_symmetry: orbit under identity, left-right reflection, black-white conjugacy, and reflection-after-conjugacy
rule_family_split.manifest_serialization: compact JSON; ordered rule-orbit list plus a train/validation/test object serialized with sort_keys=true and compact separators
rule_family_split.claim_bearing_fixtures: lexicographically minimum pair in every simultaneous pair-symmetry orbit whose two rules both belong to the test block

observation_packet.initial_state_order: ascending SHA256('ECA-OBS-ID-V0|initial_state|'+decimal_state), tie numerically; first 16 distinct states
observation_packet.assignment_manifest_serialization: compact JSON ordered list of [word,state] records
visible_to_hypothetical_learner: raw predecessor and successor ring states
forbidden_learner_inputs: rule numbers, rule embeddings, or truth tables
stable labels, depths, partition hashes, or refinement histories

query_universe.definition: all unordered distinct state pairs (x,y) with equal initial probe P0(x)=P0(y)
query_universe.manifest_serialization: compact JSON ordered list of [x,y] records
query_universe.reason: remove immediate different-probe negatives and force the scout beyond P0

version_space.definition: V(D)={(rA,rB):rA!=rB and every observed A or B transition in packet D matches the corresponding exact ECA transition}
version_space.construction_failure: V(D) is empty or excludes the true ordered rule pair
version_space.effective_unordered_hypothesis_count: number of distinct unordered rule pairs represented in V(D)
version_space.whole_partition_identifiable: every hypothesis in V(D) induces the same stable partition relation on all states
version_space.distinct_partition_relation_count: number of distinct stable same-object relations induced by V(D)
version_space.object_relation_set: L(D,x,y)={1[x and y are stably equivalent under unordered pair {rA,rB}]:(rA,rB) in V(D)}
version_space.consensus_without_identification: at least eight effective unordered hypotheses remain, at least two distinct full partition relations remain, and L is singleton

regime_classification.construction_valid: no empty version spaces and every true pair remains in every version space
regime_classification.system_identification_dominated: system_identified is true for at least 90 percent of fixtures
consensus_candidate_budget: per-fixture identifiable coverage >= 0.80 for every fixture
at least 100 fixtures retain at least eight effective unordered hypotheses and at least two distinct full partition relations
at least 50000 consensus-without-identification queries across those fixtures
identifiable-same and identifiable-different each comprise at least 20 percent of consensus-without-identification queries
fewer than 50 percent of fixtures are system identified
regime_classification.perception_like_regime_admitted: two consecutive frozen budgets satisfy every consensus-candidate condition
regime_classification.earliest_admitted_budget: smallest first budget of a qualifying consecutive pair; null when none
regime_classification.future_learning_boundary: this exact scout maps all budgets; selecting a budget for learning requires a new preregistration and untouched rule families, and cannot call N9 labels blind

required_controls: all 9636 same-P0 queries present exactly once
true pair inclusion and nonempty version space at every budget
version spaces are nested monotonically as observation budget grows
unidentifiable query sets are monotonically nonincreasing as budget grows
factorized compatible-rule construction matches brute-force ordered-pair enumeration on frozen boundary fixtures
one corrupted observed transition must empty or exclude the true version
rule-token swap maps version hypotheses and preserves unordered object relation
query-order permutation preserves counts and predictably changes ordered vector hash
one identifiability-vector mutation changes the hash
all required fields compare across Julia and JAX
blocked_consumers: neural training before a separate benchmark card is admitted
general AI perception or semantic object authority
QIT stages, four substages, or the 16-by-4-by-2 schedule
MMMs, ontology admission, universal attractor, Axis0, physics, life, or consciousness
